positiveInteger.zh-CN: 请输入大于 0 的整数。

modelInvalid.en-US: The model must use the provider/model format.

listInputOptional.zh-CN: 文件匹配模式（逗号分隔，留空匹配全部）

allFiles.zh-CN: 全部文件（由规则 front matter 决定）
allFiles.en-US: All files (determined by rule front matter)

toolsInput.zh-CN: 工具范围（逗号分隔，* 表示全部工具）

conditionInput.zh-CN: 条件模块路径（留空禁用）

deleteMessage.en-US: This will delete the configuration for "{name}".

savedWarnings.zh-CN: 文件评审配置已保存，但有警告：{warnings}
savedWarnings.en-US: File review configuration saved with warnings: {warnings}

configWarnings.zh-CN: 当前配置有警告，将以可用值打开：{warnings}
configWarnings.en-US: The current configuration has warnings; opening with usable values: {warnings}

fileContextInput.zh-CN: 修改后文件上下文最大字符数

fileContextConfig.zh-CN: 修改后文件上下文上限：{value} 字符

commandDescription.zh-CN: 通过交互式菜单配置工具生命周期审查
commandDescription.en-US: Configure tool lifecycle review through an interactive menu

interactiveOnly.zh-CN: 当前模式不支持交互式配置，请使用有 UI 的 Pi 会话。
interactiveOnly.en-US: Interactive configuration is not supported in this mode; use a Pi session with a UI.

reviewAborted.zh-CN: 上级请求已终止，审查模型请求已取消或未发起。
reviewAborted.en-US: The parent request was aborted; review-model requests were cancelled or not started.

failedAfterReview.zh-CN: 工具调用失败，跳过 after 审查。
failedAfterReview.en-US: The tool call failed; after review was skipped.

unchangedFileSkipped.zh-CN: 文件内容没有变化，跳过审查。
unchangedFileSkipped.en-US: The file content did not change; review was skipped.

noApplicableGenericRules.zh-CN: 没有适用的通用工具规则。

beforeReviewRejectedFallback.zh-CN: 工具 {toolName} 未通过前置审查。
beforeReviewRejectedFallback.en-US: Tool {toolName} did not pass the before review.

conditionNotMatched.zh-CN: 条件未匹配，跳过该审查器。
conditionNotMatched.en-US: The condition did not match; this reviewer was skipped.

conditionFailed.zh-CN: 条件模块 {path} 执行失败：{message}

typesafeModelInput.zh-CN: TypeSafe 模型名（留空使用默认值）
typesafeModelInput.en-US: TypeSafe model name (empty uses the default)

modelMissing.zh-CN: 这个 reviewer 没有可用的审查模型。
modelMissing.en-US: This reviewer has no usable review model.

noJudgments.zh-CN: 没有可判断的规则：所有规则文件都缺少「## 判据」段落。
noJudgments.en-US: No judgable rules: every rule file is missing its "## Criteria" section.

unansweredJudgments.zh-CN: TypeSafe 没有返回 {count} 条规则的答案（{ids}），它们无法判定，本次审查按失败处理，不视为通过。
unansweredJudgments.en-US: TypeSafe returned no answer for {count} rules ({ids}); they could not be judged, so this review is reported as failed rather than passed.

localizationSkipped.zh-CN: 新增行超过 {count} 行，已跳过行号定位，只报告规则级别的问题。
localizationSkipped.en-US: More than {count} added lines, so line localization was skipped and issues are reported at rule level only.

localizationFailed.zh-CN: 行号定位请求失败，只报告规则级别的问题：{message}
localizationFailed.en-US: The line localization request failed, so issues are reported at rule level only: {message}

panelDescEnabled.zh-CN: 关闭后工具审查完全不执行，编辑不再经过审查模型。
panelDescEnabled.en-US: When off, tool review never runs and edits are no longer checked by a review model.

panelDescTimeout.zh-CN: 单个审查模型的请求超时；超时按审查失败处理，不打回编辑。
panelDescTimeout.en-US: Request timeout for one review model; a timeout is reported as a failed review and does not revert the edit.

panelDescFileContext.zh-CN: 发给审查模型的修改后文件内容上限，超出时只保留改动附近的片段。
panelDescFileContext.en-US: Maximum post-edit file content sent to the review model; beyond this only the area around the change is kept.

panelDescRuleLines.zh-CN: 规则文件超过该行数时发出拆分提醒，审查仍然执行。
panelDescRuleLines.en-US: Rule files longer than this produce a split warning; the review still runs.

panelDescTypesafeApiKey.zh-CN: 留空时回退到 TYPESAFE_API_KEY 环境变量。
panelDescTypesafeApiKey.en-US: Empty falls back to the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable.

panelDescTypesafeEndpoint.zh-CN: 留空时回退到 TYPESAFE_ENDPOINT 环境变量。
panelDescTypesafeEndpoint.en-US: Empty falls back to the TYPESAFE_ENDPOINT environment variable.

panelDescAddReviewer.zh-CN: 依次填写名称、引擎、模型与规则文件，保存后立刻生效。
panelDescAddReviewer.en-US: Asks for a name, engine, model and rule files in turn; takes effect as soon as it is saved.

panelDescReviewerEnabled.zh-CN: 关闭后该审查器不参与触发，其余审查器不受影响。
panelDescReviewerEnabled.en-US: When off, this reviewer never triggers; other reviewers are unaffected.

panelDescReviewerName.zh-CN: 审计卡片和未通过诊断里显示的名字。
panelDescReviewerName.en-US: Name shown in the audit card and in rejection diagnostics.

panelDescBackend.zh-CN: 对话模型把 diff 交给模型判断；TypeSafe 把规则当判据交给 System One。
panelDescBackend.en-US: Chat model sends the diff to a model; TypeSafe sends each rule to System One as a judgment.

panelDescModel.zh-CN: 回车打开可搜索的可用模型列表，输入任意片段都能过滤。
panelDescModel.en-US: Enter opens a searchable list of available models; typing any fragment filters it.

panelDescRulesFiles.zh-CN: 逗号分隔；至少一个，留空不会被接受。
panelDescRulesFiles.en-US: Comma-separated; at least one is required and an empty value is rejected.

panelDescTools.zh-CN: 逗号分隔的工具名；填 * 表示全部工具。
panelDescTools.en-US: Comma-separated tool names; * means every tool.

panelDescTrigger.zh-CN: before 在工具执行前审查，未通过会直接阻止该次调用；after 在执行后审查。
panelDescTrigger.en-US: Before reviews ahead of the tool and blocks the call when it fails; after reviews once the tool has run.

panelDescCondition.zh-CN: 本地 JS 模块路径，返回是否应用本审查器；留空表示始终应用。
panelDescCondition.en-US: Path to a local JS module that decides whether this reviewer applies; empty means always.

panelDescFilePatterns.zh-CN: 逗号分隔的 glob；留空匹配全部文件（仍受规则 front matter 约束）。
panelDescFilePatterns.en-US: Comma-separated globs; empty matches every file (rule front matter still applies).

panelDescRemove.zh-CN: 从配置里移除该审查器，会先让你确认。
panelDescRemove.en-US: Removes this reviewer from the configuration; you are asked to confirm first.
